name: Tapita SEO Optimizer
summary: All-in-one Shopify SEO app: site audits with LLMs.txt for AI search engines, bulk and AI-written metadata, image alt text and compression, JSON-LD schema, broken-link auto-redirects and one-click speed fixes.
best_for: Shopify merchants on the Basic or Grow plan who want SEO audits, bulk metadata, image alt text and speed fixes out of one app instead of hiring a specialist
skip_if: you are on Shopify Advanced or Plus, where the same tier costs $30 to $60 a month more, or you need a published per-credit rate before you build a month of AI metadata around it
honest_knock:
The price on the listing is a Shopify-Basic price, and almost nobody reads the line underneath it. The same Premium plan is $49.99 on Shopify Basic, $54.99 on Grow, $79.99 on Advanced and $109.99 on Shopify Plus, because Tapita adds $5, $30 or $60 a month on top depending on your Shopify plan. On the Business tier the spread is sevenfold, $9.99 to $69.99, and it is the single largest factor in what this app costs you. Work out which row you are on before you compare it to anything else.

The ladder also moved. On our reads of 21 August and 10 September 2026 the top tier was Pro at $39.99 a month; on 9 October 2026 it is Premium at $49.99, $10 more before any surcharge.

The second meter has no published rate at all. Business gives you 100 AI metadata credits a month and Premium 500, and beyond that the listing says only that more audit pages and more credits carry an extra charge. It does not say how much, and it does not say how many credits one product's metadata consumes. Tapita's own sister app publishes $0.06 a credit on its listing; this one publishes nothing, so you cannot price a month of AI metadata before you install.

And the free tier is a demonstration rather than a plan: 50 products for bulk alt text and file names, 30 images a day, and the SEO audit and LLMs.txt limited to basic pages.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Business · per month on the Shopify Basic plan
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-09 on apps.shopify.com/google-seo-schema-meta-data) Three tiers. Free: SEO audit and LLMs.txt on basic pages, unlimited on-page SEO audit, essential JSON-LD schemas, image compression 900 a month capped at 30 a day, bulk and AI metadata optimisation, bulk image alt text and file names for 50 products, instant page speed and 24/7 support chat for common SEO issues. Business $9.99 a month or $101.88 a year, advertised as a 15% saving (it checks out: $101.88 against $119.88), adds full features, support to fix all SEO and Google Search Console issues, SEO audit and LLMs.txt on main pages, auto image optimisation 100 a day, 100 AI metadata credits a month, broken-link detection with auto-redirects and advanced speed features. Premium $49.99 a month or $509.88 a year, also 15% ($509.88 against $599.88), adds regular page-speed and real-user-monitoring optimisation, SEO audit and LLMs.txt on all main pages, 500 images a day, 500 AI credits a month, higher speed capacity and an onboarding call. Both paid tiers carry the same surcharge line, and it is the number that decides what this costs: +$5 a month on the Shopify Grow plan, +$30 on Advanced and +$60 on Shopify Plus. So Business is $9.99, $14.99, $39.99 or $69.99, and Premium is $49.99, $54.99, $79.99 or $109.99, depending on which Shopify plan you are on (our arithmetic on the listed rates). Extra audit pages and extra AI credits are billed on top and the listing does not print a per-credit rate. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Historical: on our reads of 21 August and 10 September 2026 the paid tiers were called Basic ($9.99, $101.88 a year) and Pro ($39.99, $408 a year), and Pro then listed unlimited keyword research, which no tier lists on 9 October 2026. Developer Tapita, M5 Building, 91 Nguyen Chi Thanh, Hanoi; the app launched 15 March 2023 and carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge.
